column1: # Labelled queries for tuning skill search.  query <TAB> acceptable skill names, comma separated
# Written in the phrasing someone would actually type, deliberately NOT paraphrased from the
# skill descriptions. Copying description wording would hand the lexical scorer the answer and
# make any weight above zero look worse than it is.
# Several targets are listed where more than one skill is a defensible answer; a hit on any of
# them counts. Duplicate skill names in the library are fine — matching is by name.
